summary: leakdeep 2.5.0 harvests browser credentials and Discord tokens, exfiltrates to Discord webhook
details: The package ships an infostealer behind an OSINT-tool cover story. The console_script entry point `leakdeep` calls SystemInfo.initialize_background_process() in main() before any argument handling, so simply running the installed CLI spawns a background thread that collects host identity (getpass.getuser, platform.node, public IP via api.ipify.org), decrypts Chrome/Edge/Brave saved logins using win32crypt and AES-GCM against the browser Login Data stores, and harvests Discord tokens from the Local Storage\leveldb directory. The collected data is zipped and POSTed to a hardcoded Discord webhook at https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1561071611430572052/... in leakdeep/core/sysinfo.py. There is no user opt-in, configuration, or disclosure of this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
